The usual litany of climate-change signs - melting glaciers, forest fires, floods, droughts and hurricanes - are on hand here. But revelational is the increase in zoonotic diseases - diseases that pass to humans from animals - which include SARS, the Ebola virus, HIV and COVID-19.
